improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered AI assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="GDN AI">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. The copy highlights key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, trade focus) and the low-friction entry point (three free searches) without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and trade professionals. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately names the product (Gideon), clarifies what it does (AI assistant for trade and business), and highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace). The subheading addresses the free trial offer directly with a low-friction CTA ('no card required'), reducing hesitation and encouraging first engagement. The tone is confident and professional without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose monthly flexibility or save 30 percent with an annual plan.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating the low entry price, and highlighting key benefits, it reduces uncertainty and increases conversion likelihood. It also reinforces value before the prospect hits the paywall.
